description: List the store's orders, newest first, optionally by status (draft, pending, failed, canceled, inprocess, onhold, partial, fulfilled, archived). Printful: GET /orders.

status.description: Order status, e.g. draft, pending, fulfilled, failed.

store_id.description: Store id (numeric) for an ACCOUNT-level token; overrides PRINTFUL_STORE_ID. Not needed with a store-level token.
